items.source: DefaultChatClient uses this marker to detect whether a tool-call handling advisor is already present in the chain, and to avoid auto-registering a duplicate.
items.translation: DefaultChatClient 使用该标记来检测工具调用处理顾问是否已存在于链中，并避免自动注册重复项。

items.source:
Marker interface for advisors that own the tool-call lifecycle. An advisor implementing
this interface takes responsibility for executing tools and driving the tool-call loop,
replacing the model-internal tool execution path.
items.translation: 为拥有工具调用生命周期的顾问定义的标记接口。实现此接口的顾问负责执行工具并驱动工具调用循环，从而替代模型内部的工具执行路径。
